name: Electric submersible pumps
principle: A downhole multistage centrifugal pump driven by a submersible motor on a cable lifts 16 to 4,770 m³/d (100 to 30,000 bbl/d). SLB reports an installed base of 150,000 to 200,000 wells and notes ESPs are usually uneconomic below about 25 m³/d.

process_steps.name: Surface drive sends power down the cable
Pump lifts fluid; gas separator removes free gas
